headline: Official Removal Of Gibran Rakabuming Raka Portraits In Indonesia
seoTitle: Gibran Rakabuming Raka Portraits Removed In Indonesia
metaDescription: Following his resignation as Vice President, portraits of Gibran Rakabuming Raka are being removed from government offices across Indonesia.
aiSummaryBullets: Government offices in Jakarta have begun removing portraits of the former Vice President following authorization from the central government.
The Indonesian National Police have also taken down official photographs of the former Vice President after his resignation.
Earlier reports indicated incidents where portraits were removed or displayed upside down in regional legislative buildings in West Java.
aiContextParagraph: The removal of official portraits of Gibran Rakabuming Raka from government buildings follows his recent resignation as the Vice President of Indonesia. In response to the leadership change, the Jakarta Provincial Government, led by Governor Pramono Anung, coordinated with central authorities to standardize the removal process across all provincial offices. Similar actions were observed within the Indonesian National Police, who have initiated the removal of the former Vice President's image from their facilities. This development follows earlier public incidents in West Java, where portraits of the former official were removed or displayed inverted at the regional legislative council, an action local leaders described as a spontaneous reaction to the resignation. These procedural adjustments are currently taking place across various administrative sectors to ensure official displays reflect the current government structure after his departure from office.
whyItIsViral: The story has gained significant traction with a high coverage velocity across multiple major news outlets following the resignation of a high-ranking official.
